definitions.gloss: Tokyo metropolitan area; greater Tokyo; capital region
definitions.explanation: The region centered on Tokyo, generally including the surrounding prefectures of Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki, Tochigi, Gunma, and Yamanashi. Home to approximately 36 million people.

examples.japanese: {首都圏|しゅとけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in the Tokyo metropolitan area.

examples.english: Transportation in the Tokyo metropolitan area was severely disrupted due to the typhoon.

notes: Frequently appears in news and weather forecasts. The formal definition under the Capital Region Development Act includes Tokyo and seven surrounding prefectures. In everyday use, it often refers more narrowly to Tokyo and the three adjacent prefectures ({神奈川|かながわ}, {埼玉|さいたま}, {千葉|ちば}). Related terms: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ (the Kanto region, a broader geographical term), ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧ (central Tokyo), {近畿圏|きんきけん} (Kinki/Kansai metropolitan area).
